exposure: early urinary catheter removal (at 6 hours post-CS)
routine urinary catheter removal (>6 hours post-CS)
outcome: first void time after catheter removal
cohort: The study included 158 patients who underwent cesarean section (CS) at Government Medical College Manjeri, excluding those requiring longer catheterization due to bladder injury or eclampsia.
finding: Early removal of urinary catheters after CS was associated with earlier mobilization and a reduced hospital stay, without an increase in urinary retention or re-catheterization.
